closed_findings.issue: texture reread five raw fields already decoded by indexTextures, leaving inventory/codec header meaning in two places.
closed_findings.resolution: Final texture consumes selected.Header Width/Height/Depth/RasterFormat/Version. Only four declaration lines changed; reversing them reproduces initial texture SHA dabdb7c88304cae2c5791e6e108e1b6765d3af742df14e85ffb20827c10e80f1 exactly. No policy/guard changed.

assessment.ownership: One genuine shared RW structural parser serves texture and authorTexture inventory (Serena confirms both references). Codec signature remains unchanged; format/GS/storage/alpha/CLUT/pixel/writer decisions stay with existing owners. Inventory uses one explicit read-only profile operation, not a codec policy mode.
assessment.local_and_global_errors: Dictionary extent/count, native envelope/name and global traversal failures remain global. Per-entry info/pixel-struct errors retain their text and do not reject another selected raster. Order and duplicate names are preserved; selected metadata errors precede selector cardinality as before.
assessment.chunk_budget: Global count includes dictionary/native envelopes. Each metadata entry records attempted child count and local errors against that global count. texture adds only matching entry counts cumulatively before surfacing their errors, preserving duplicate-selected budget precedence; unselected metadata consumption does not spend the old selected traversal budget. Inspection found no counterexample. Root103-case differential is supplemental evidence, not an independent rerun.
assessment.raw_inventory: Dimensions/depth/format/version are raw uint fields; inventory does not apply raster calibration or claim preview/decode support. codec_support=not_evaluated and limits make that explicit. It forbids selectors/images/render/policies/apply/output, validates source pins and publishes JSON only.
assessment.old_behavior: Remaining codec body is unchanged except descriptor spans/shared header reads. Focused CLI includes existing export/import/render/refusal flows; no shared publisher or placement behavior changed.

checks.independent_CLI: PASS same5 cases on initial and final binaries: real e01 dictionary27 names/raw header projections; empty dictionary returns[]; wrong dictionary extent/count and invalid global name refuse without report. All source/profile bytes,inode,mtime and directory contents preserved.
checks.oracle_basis: Actual fixture source plus all27 native chunk/name/hash records are rebound to precode small-psmt8-native-contract; raw headers are projected directly from fixed native records, not copied from Go output.

evidence.root_differential_scope: Initial candidate:103 deterministic complete stdout/stderr/exit comparisons, including chunk boundaries; not exhaustive and not rerun by this reviewer.
